newsitem.title: COMOROS: Arrest of activist angers Comoros secessionists.
newsitem.headline: Arrest of activist angers Comoros secessionists.

text.p: Supporters of a secessionist movement on Anjouan, largest island in the Comoran archipelago, protested on Sunday after a hotel owner and leader of the movement, Chakirane Ahmed, 65, was arrested.
They said the Saturday arrest would only increase support for a massive demonstration planned for Monday -- the French national day -- in support of their call for Anjouan to return to France.

Anjouan and most other islands in the Indian Ocean group declared their independence from France in 1975, but Mayotte island, which lies east of Anjouan, remained French. The Anjouan islanders say independence has brought only poverty and political unrest.

Residents said Ahmed's arrest had angered the young islanders who provide the main support for the seccession movement. Members of his family said they had been unable to see Ahmed since his arrest, and feared for his health.
